evidence.excerpt: إِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرٗا مِّن طِينٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Fire-over-clay superiority claim producing expulsion and curse
candidates.definition: In 38:74-78: Except Iblees, he was arrogant and became of the disbelievers; what prevented you from prostrating to what I created with My hands; I am better than him, You created me from fire and him from clay; then get out of Paradise, you are expelled; upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense.

evidence.excerpt: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

candidates.label: Bounded reprieve and the misguidance oath answered by the divine truth-oath
candidates.definition: In 38:79-85: My Lord, reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected; you are of those reprieved until the Day of the time well-known; by Your might I will mislead them all except Your chosen servants; the truth is My oath, I will fill Hell with you and those who follow you all together.
